lesson: When decomposing a task into sub-pipelines, each sub-pipeline boundary must define an explicit interface contract (shared schema, API spec, or data model). If two sub-pipelines share a unit without a documented interface, merge them.
rationale: Tightly coupled sub-pipelines without documented interfaces cause integration failures in later phases. The decomposition validator should require an interface_spec for every entry in dependency_graph, not just a dependency arrow.
